title_chain.zh_h1: 理性主义与经验主义 rationalism vs. empiricism (Peter Markie and M. Folescu)

spot.html_text: We have stated the basic claims of rationalism and empiricism so that each is relative to a particular subject area. Rationalism and empiricism, so relativized, need not conflict. We can be rationalists in mathematics or a particular area of mathematics and empiricists in all or some of the physical sciences. spot.html_text: What is the nature of propositional knowledge, knowledge that a particular proposition about the world, ourselves, morality, or beauty is true?
